diagnosis: Customer wants to rotate an API token tied to an ETL job. Account uses Unified Auth, so it uses scoped keys. Recommend KB-0003 for steps and note that identity verification by a named owner may be needed per KB-0018.
reply: Thank you for contacting us about your API credential. On your plan, credentials are managed as scoped keys — you create a new key, redirect your ETL job to use it, then revoke the previous key. Keep in mind revocation takes effect immediately, so please ensure all traffic is moved first. If you need a credential action that changes entitlements, a named account owner must confirm it. You can find the detailed steps in our article on rotating scoped API keys.
